caption:
Manuals. Standards. Drawings. Lab reports. And more.
Years of knowledge, scattered everywhere.
Which attraction needs immediate attention? Show me the proof.
One question. One answer, with the proof.

Introducing En-Genie, your one-stop AI assistant
to find, verify and deliver knowledge.
Give it any file.
A manual with hundreds of pages.
A spreadsheet with thousands of rows.

What's the C-frame drawing number at Mine Train,
its NDT requirement, and any MRB records?
One question. Three sources, cross-checked.
And it pinpoints the exact part on the 3D model.

A pile of scanned lab reports?
One clean tracker, built automatically.

Find the Mine Train and Tron layouts,
and photos of the real trains.
It even searches pictures.
Normally, live data needs engineers, code and setup.
With En-Genie, no code, no setup, just ask.

Every day, tell my team in Teams which trains
are out of service or on standby.
Done. The alert lands in Teams, every day.

Every week, email the ride downtime report
to Mickey, Minnie, Donald and Goofy.
Every week, on time, with the summary built in.
Built for every team, with one shared source of knowledge.
En-Genie. Engineering the magic.
